scripts.generate:client:ts: rm -rf fetch-client; openapi-generator-cli generate -i ../spec/ladon.yml -g typescript-fetch -o fetch-client --additional-properties=supportsES6=true --additional-properties=disallowAdditionalPropertiesIfNotPresent=false
scripts.generate:client:ng: rm -rf angular-client; openapi-generator-cli generate -i  ../spec/ladon.yml -g typescript-angular -o angular-client --additional-properties=apiModulePrefix=Ladon,ngVersion=19
scripts.generate:apis: npm run generate:client:ts & npm run generate:client:ng
